title: Discover companies and collect current jobs
summary: Run bounded company discovery and public careers collection, storing companies, jobs, source metadata, collection outcomes and request-budget usage.
use_when: New employers and postings should be found through configured recurring query families.
Previously discovered employer careers sources should be refreshed with ordinary HTTP.
do_not_use_when: The request is only to inspect retained results.
The caller needs personal job selection, application preparation, contact or a browser/agent fallback.
outcome: One recorded bounded collection run with retained discoveries and explicit completed, incomplete, deferred or failed source work.

interfaces.label: Collect without waiting for due times

effects: Reads configured sources over HTTP, may consume TheirStack credits or Brave search allowance, and writes extracted company/job records plus run, source, cursor and budget state.
Does not retain whole provider responses or invoke another Cell product.
authority: Cast owns source admission, extracted retained observations, identity correlation and conservative local accounting.
External sources supply response fields and posting records; providers handle billing.
success: The bounded run settles its admitted work and retains both discoveries and explicit coverage/error outcomes.
The run result records each selected source outcome and the resulting snapshot revision.
failure_and_recovery: Run and source diagnostics record missing credentials, budget deferrals and unsupported pages for the selected collection work.
Failed or partial fetches do not add missing observations. Later runs retry due work under stored state and budgets.
privacy: Configured search terms and source requests leave the machine for their providers. Extracted evidence and posting text remain in private local state unless the caller exports it.
Credentials are supplied through THEIRSTACK_API_KEY and BRAVE_SEARCH_API_KEY and are not printed or stored in collection config.
does_not_authorize: Selecting jobs for the user, creating CRM cases or application packets, sending email, submitting applications, invoking an agent or browser, or enabling a schedule.

consumers.statement: The current user may invoke configured company discovery and careers-source refresh through the local Cast CLI.

preconditions.statement: The caller selects initialized Cast state, valid configuration, network access, and credentials for enabled paid providers; local request budgets admit each request.

inputs.statement: Inputs are persisted query configuration, current query/source cursors, selected state directory and optional force flag. Force bypasses due-time selection, not request budgets.

outputs.statement: Collection emits a run result and retains normalized companies, jobs, source health, query coverage and conservative budget usage.

data_semantics.statement: First/last seen are Cast observation times. Provider publication/update dates are separate fields. Failed and partial fetches do not add missing observations. The employer_jsonld_owned adapter rule requires a hiring-organization root homepage URL without query/fragment whose host matches the page/job host or its parent employer domain. Shared recruiting hosts such as join.com and curriculo.me require a separate adapter; search and directory results use their own attribution kinds.

identity_and_units.statement: Opaque company/job/source identities belong to Cast; native identifiers remain source-scoped. ATS sources use canonical provider/tenant owners independently of linking websites or aggregators. Website-domain and ATS-tenant records can remain separate even when names match. Local counters use TheirStack credits, Brave requests, HTTP requests and elapsed seconds.

completeness_and_freshness.statement: Each source outcome records the pages or items collected, limits reached and request status. Successful observation and latest-attempt times are stored separately.
Collection stores returned company and job fields, source metadata and per-request outcomes.

access.statement: The local process uses bounded HTTP adapters. No model, browser, Nucleus, CRM or email capability is invoked.

lifecycle_and_consistency.statement: Collection serializes writers for one state directory, persists checkpoint and budget state, and leaves incomplete work inspectable for subsequent runs.

operational_limits.statement: Default local caps are 200 total and 60 daily TheirStack credits, 1,000 monthly and 30 daily Brave requests, 500 HTTP requests per run, 3,000 daily HTTP requests, a 600-second run deadline and 50 careers-source collections per run.
No provider-availability, completion-latency or future API-compatibility service level is promised.

compatibility_and_evolution.statement: Capability version 1 publishes Cast 0.1 collection behavior; configuration and export schema versions remain separate.
No future migration or deprecation window is promised.

reliances.statement: Discovery depends on TheirStack, Brave and Hacker News source APIs when configured. Their external billing, returned data and availability have no dedicated installed Chancery contract.
Careers collection uses employer websites and supported public ATS APIs; no dedicated installed Chancery contract covers those interfaces.
